start.title: Факелы в деревьях
start.text:
Свет факелов заливает оливковую рощу.
Иуда ведёт вооружённых людей к тебе.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The hour will not be hidden from.
[TODO:ru] You step into the torchlight.
[TODO:ru] Not by power, but by surrender.

hide_consequence.title: Не скрываясь
hide_consequence.text:
Воля Отца должна быть исполнена открыто.
Выйди на свет.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You rise to meet them.

angels_consequence.title: Двенадцать легионов ждут
angels_consequence.text:
Небеса могли бы спасти тебя в одно мгновение.
Но Писание должно исполниться.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You set your face like flint.

judas_arrives.title: Друг, зачем ты пришёл?
judas_arrives.text:
Иуда идёт впереди толпы.
Его фонарь дрожит в руке.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Meet betrayal with grace.
[TODO:ru] Stay. The cup is here.
[TODO:ru] Your voice is soft, unbroken.

shame_consequence.title: Благодать, а не гнев
shame_consequence.text:
Даже сейчас любовь — твой ответ.
Пусть он услышит это ещё раз.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His eyes break under your gaze.

run_consequence.title: Чаша здесь
run_consequence.text:
Ты не молился всю ночь, чтобы бежать.
Встреть его там, где стоишь.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You hold your ground in peace.

kiss.title: Знак поцелуя
kiss.text:
Иуда наклоняется близко. «Равви!»
Его губы касаются твоей щеки в предательстве.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] No violence answers this kiss.
[TODO:ru] "Do what you came to do."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Pretend you do not know him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Truth, even now. Especially now.

strike_consequence.title: Не мечом
strike_consequence.text:
Даже Иуда любим до конца.
Пусть поцелуй станет его свидетельством.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your stillness is louder than wrath.

pretend_consequence.title: Истина, даже сейчас
pretend_consequence.text:
Отрицание — не твой путь.
Встреть его лицом к лицу.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You stand fully revealed.

step_forward.title: Кого вы ищете?
step_forward.text:
Стражники останавливаются на краю света.
Их глаза ищут учеников.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let the disciples be taken too
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Shield them. The hour is yours alone.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand silent and let them guess
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Speak. Name yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your words fall like a quiet thunder.

let_taken_consequence.title: Защити их
let_taken_consequence.text:
Никто из них не должен быть потерян этой ночью.
Ты пьёшь эту чашу один.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The guards step back at your voice.

silent_consequence.title: Назови себя
silent_consequence.text:
Истина должна быть сказана в темноте.
Объяви, кто ты.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "I am he. Let these men go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The crowd staggers and falls back.

peter_sword.title: [TODO:ru] Peter Draws Steel
peter_sword.text:
[TODO:ru] Peter lifts a sword above his head.
It flashes toward the high priest's servant.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] This is not the kingdom's way.
[TODO:ru] Peter freezes, sword still raised.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take the sword and fight beside him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The kingdom is not won by blades.

cheer_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Not by Blades
cheer_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Those who live by the sword die by it.
Speak the harder word.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Peter lowers the blade trembling.

fight_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Cup, Not the Sword
fight_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The Father's plan needs no defenders.
It needs a willing Son.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your calm halts the night.

heal_ear.title: [TODO:ru] No More of This
heal_ear.text:
[TODO:ru] The servant clutches his bleeding ear.
Fear and pain shake his whole frame.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Walk past him to be arrested
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Even now, mercy. Heal him.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Warmth flows. The wound closes.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Curse the men who came for you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Bless, do not curse, tonight.

walk_past_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Mercy, Always
walk_past_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The last miracle before the cross
belongs to your enemy.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] He looks up at you, stunned.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bless, Not Curse
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Love your enemies, you taught.
Live it now, in the torchlight.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Touch his ear and heal him
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The grove falls silent in awe.

disciples_flee.title: [TODO:ru] They All Forsook Him
disciples_flee.text:
[TODO:ru] Your friends turn and run.
Cloaks drop. Footsteps fade into the dark.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Let mercy cover their fear.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let them go without a word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You watch them with quiet love.
[TODO:ru] They will return. Forgive them now.

call_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Let Them Go
call_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The Shepherd is struck. Sheep scatter.
It was written. It is right.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let them go without a word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Their footsteps fade into the night.

curse_friends_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Forgive Them
curse_friends_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] They will weep and return.
Leave the door of love open.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Let them go without a word
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Forgiveness goes ahead of them.

taken_away.title: [TODO:ru] Bound and Led
taken_away.text:
[TODO:ru] Rope tightens around your wrists.
The road to Jerusalem opens ahead.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Walk with peace into the dawn.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Beg to be released one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The yes is already spoken.
[TODO:ru] Your steps are sure and slow.

struggle_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Peace in the Cords
struggle_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] These ropes you have chosen freely.
Wear them like a king.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your head lifts toward the dawn.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Already Yes
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] In the garden you said your yes.
Let the body follow the heart.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The path is yours to walk.

ending.title: [TODO:ru] Led Toward the Dawn
ending.text:
[TODO:ru] Torches line the road to the city.
You walk in peace toward what comes.
